headline: The prefilter re-flagged Grumpy Walrus's 6:11 PM MOGE buy (same ~13.96M, no new MOGE trade). Since the 7 PM run it only bought ~343 NIGHT for ~78 ADA and ~207 FLOW for ~71 ADA (net ADA ~-149). Two new swarm launches, AIDA (9 coordinated, 4 fresh, 6 snipers already out) and SNEKG (11 coordinated, 5 fresh, 5 serial early buyers), are Pass and logged for SW-01 tracking. COCK side ~145.1k, 3.3% under its line. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: the prefilter re-sends a whale_move for a position it already flagged (MOGE, same quantity), so a repeat whale_move with an unchanged delta is not a new buy.
